No Gravity: Completely zeroes out the game's gravity. When you jump or fall, you'll just float and drift in the air.

Custom Keybind: If you are playing on a PC, you can easily change the menu toggle key to any other key on your keyboard.

Profile Indicator: A sleek info bar at the bottom of the menu automatically fetches and displays your current Roblox username and avatar picture.
